draft.subject: A hand with your first project in Wrenfield?
draft.body:
Hi Jordan,

Checking in since you joined Wrenfield last week. If a first project is still on your list, the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project \u2014 projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. When you're ready to bring in the rest of Lantern Labs, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm glad to walk through the first steps with you and answer anything that comes up.

Best,
Chidi
